verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a browsable domain marketplace with server-side filters (porkbun-docs-24) and an expired-domain closeout channel with fixed descending prices (porkbun-docs-23, porkbun-docs-36), which gives an aftermarket path. Its availability check returns pricing across TLDs (porkbun-docs-35), but nothing says premium-tier pricing is surfaced in search or that taken names can be pursued through brokerage. missing for 10: explicit premium-domain pricing in search results, a broker or acquisition path for currently registered names, independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace.
